en: Colorized illustrated postcard. On the left, a panoramic view over a river valley town with red‑roofed houses, a large church or town hall with a tall tower, several factory chimneys and bridges, surrounded by wooded hills; the caption at the top reads "Waldheim. Blick vom Eichberg." On the right, a separate cartoon panel shows a smiling, well‑dressed man with glasses, hat and umbrella standing on a rock, gesturing toward the landscape below, with a humorous dialect text printed beside him.
